title: An all-sky map of half a million supermassive black holes
summary: The Sloan Digital Sky Survey (SDSS) Black Hole Mapper has released its second major dataset, containing spectroscopic measurements of approximately 500,000 supermassive black holes (quasars), creating the largest-ever all-sky map of these cosmic objects and enabling unprecedented studies of the universe's large-scale structure.
problem_solved: Provides the most comprehensive spectroscopic catalog of supermassive black holes for studying cosmological structure and black hole evolution.
why_valuable: This dataset enables researchers to map the universe's large-scale structure and understand how supermassive black holes influence galaxy formation across cosmic time.
